Indemnifi</font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="ITEM_6_INDEMNIFICATION_DIRECTORS_FICERS"></a>cation o</font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">f Directors and Officers</font></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Deeds of Indemnity </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:4pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Directors appointed have entered into deeds of indemnity with Rio Tinto plc and Rio Tinto Limited as follows: Ann Godbehere on 9 February&#160;2010, Chris Lynch on 1 September&#160;2011, Simon Thompson on 15 April&#160;2014, Michael L&#8217;Estrange on 16 September 2014, Megan Clark on 26 November 2014, Jean-S&#233;bastien Jacques on March&#160;17, 2016, David Constable on February&#160;10, 2017, Sam Laidlaw on February&#160;10, 2017 and Simon Henry on April&#160;1, 2017. On January&#160;9, 2017, Rio Tinto plc and Rio Tinto Limited each entered into deeds of indemnity with Steve Allen, Company Secretary of Rio Tinto plc and Joint Company Secretary of Rio Tinto Limited. On September&#160;26, 2013, Rio Tinto Limited entered into a deed of indemnity with Tim Paine, Joint Company Secretary of Rio Tinto Limited.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:13pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Australian Law </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Corporation Act of Australia </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Section&#160;199A(1) of the Corporations Act 2001 (Commonwealth) (the &#8220;Corporations Act&#8221;) provides that a company or a related body corporate must not exempt a person from a liability to the company incurred as an officer of the company. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Section&#160;199A(2) of the Corporations Act provides that a company or a related body corporate must not indemnify a person against any of the following liabilities incurred as an officer of the company: </p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:6.62%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8226;</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">a liability owed to the company or a related body corporate; </p></td></tr></table></div>

<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">a liability that is owed to someone other than the company or a related body corporate that did not arise out of conduct in good faith. </p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Section&#160;199A(2) does not apply to a liability for legal costs. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Section&#160;199A(3) provides that a company or a related body corporate must not indemnify a person against legal costs incurred in defending an action for a liability incurred as an officer of the company if the costs are incurred: </p>
<div align="left">

<tr>

<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">

<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">in defending or resisting proceedings in which the person is found to have a liability for which they could not be indemnified under Section&#160;199A(2); or </p></td></tr></table></div>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">in defending or resisting proceedings brought by the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) or a liquidator for a court order if the grounds for making the order are found by the court to have been established (this does not apply to costs incurred in responding to actions taken by ASIC or a liquidator as part of an investigation before commencing proceedings for the court order); or</p></td></tr></table></div>

<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8226;</font></p></td>

<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU6"></a><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Section&#160;199B of the Corporations Act provides that a company or a related body corporate must not pay, or agree to pay, a premium for a contract insuring a person who is or has been an officer of the company against a liability (other than one for legal co</font><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">sts) arising out of: </font></p>

<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8226;</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">conduct involving a willful breach of any duty in relation to the company; or </p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">

<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8226;</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">a contravention of the officer&#8217;s duties under the Corporations Act not to improperly use their position or make improper use of information obtained as an officer. </p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">For the purpose of Sections 199A and 199B, an &#8220;officer&#8221; of a company includes: </p>

<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:6.62%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8226;</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">a director or secretary; </p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:6.62%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8226;</font></p></td>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">a person who makes, or participates in making, decisions that affect the whole, or a substantial part, of the business of the company; </p></td></tr></table></div>

<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">a person who has the capacity to significantly affect the company&#8217;s financial standing; and </p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">

<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:6.62%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8226;</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">a person in accordance with whose instructions or wishes the directors of the company are accustomed to act. </p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">English law </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Sections 232 to 236 of the Companies Act 2006 provide as follows: </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;232. Provisions protecting directors from liability </p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(1)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">Any provision that purports to exempt a director of a company (to any extent) from any liability that would otherwise attach to him in connection with any negligence, default, breach of duty or breach of trust in relation to the company is void. </p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(2)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">Any provision by which a company directly or indirectly provides an indemnity (to any extent) for a director of the company, or of an associated company, against any liability attaching to him in connection with any negligence, default, breach of duty or breach of trust in relation to the company of which he is a director is void, except as permitted by &#8212; </p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(a)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">section 233 (provision of insurance), </p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(b)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">section 234 (qualifying third party indemnity provision), or </p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">

<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(c)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">section 235 (qualifying pension scheme indemnity provision). </p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">

<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(3)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">This section applies to any provision, whether contained in a company&#8217;s articles or in any contract with the company or otherwise. </p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">

<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(4)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">Nothing in this section prevents a company&#8217;s articles from making such provision as has previously been lawful for dealing with conflicts of interest. </p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">233. Provision of insurance </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Section&#160;232(2) (voidness of provisions for indemnifying directors) does not prevent a company from purchasing and maintaining for a director of the company, or of an associated company, insurance against any such liability as is mentioned in that subsection. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU7"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">234. Qualifying third party indemnity provision </font></p>
<div align="left">

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">235. Qualifying pension scheme indemnity provision </p>

<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">236. Qualifying indemnity provision to be disclosed in directors&#8217; report </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">This section requires disclosure in the directors&#8217; report of &#8212; </p></td></tr></table></div>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#160;</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#160;</p>

<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(b)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">a person employed by a company as auditor (whether he is or is not an officer of the company), </p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:11pt;margin-left:3.97%;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">it appears to the court hearing the case that the officer or person is or may be liable but that he acted honestly and reasonably, and that having regard to all the circumstances of the case (including those connected with his appointment) he ought fairly to be excused, the court may relieve him, either wholly or in part, from his liability on such terms as it thinks fit. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#160;</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(2)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">If any such officer or person has reason to apprehend that a claim will or might be made against him in respect of negligence, default, breach of duty or breach of trust &#8212; </p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(a)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">he may apply to the court for relief, and </p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(b)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-top:11pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">the court has the same power to relieve him as it would have had if it had been a court before which proceedings against him for negligence, default, breach of duty or breach of trust had been brought. </p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#160;</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.97%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(3)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:11pt;">Where a case to which subsection (1)&#160;applies is being tried by a judge with a jury, the judge, after hearing the evidence, may, if he is satisfied that the defendant (in Scotland, the defender) ought in pursuance of that subsection to be relieved either in whole or in part from the liability sought to be enforced against him, withdraw the case from the jury and forthwith direct judgment to be entered for the defendant (in Scotland, grant decree of absolvitor) on such terms as to costs (in Scotland, expenses) or otherwise as the judge may think proper&#8221;. </p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="ITEM_7_EXEMPTION_FROM_REGISTRATION_CLAIM"></a><a name="ITEM_7_EXEMPTION_FROM_REGISTRATION_CLAIM"></a>Item&#160;7. In the event that a claim for indemnification against such liabilities (other than the payment by the registrant of expenses incurred or paid by a director, officer or controlling person of the registrant in the successful defense of any action, suit or proceeding) is asserted by such director, officer or controlling person in connection with the securities being registered, the registrant will, unless in the opinion of its counsel the matter has been settled by controlling precedent, submit to a court of appropriate jurisdiction the question whether such indemnification by it is against public policy as expressed in the Securities Act and will be governed by the final adjudication of such issue. </p>

<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">i</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><a name="_Toc213663640"></a><a name="_Toc213664488"></a><a name="_Toc213664703"></a><a name="_Toc213664822"></a><a name="_Toc213665002"></a><a name="_Toc215978124"></a><a name="_Toc215978403"></a><a name="_Toc407612718"></a><a name="_Toc407612750"></a><a name="_Toc407612817"></a><a name="_Toc407612906"></a><a name="_Toc407612966"></a><a name="_Toc505264893"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU3"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Introduction</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Plan allows for the grant of Awards in the form of:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="color:#000058;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#45;</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;"><font style="font-family:Arial;color:#000000;">Conditional Awards - Awards under which the Participant receives Shares for free automatically to the extent the Award Vests;</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="color:#000058;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#45;</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;"><font style="font-family:Arial;color:#000000;">Options - Awards under which the Participant can acquire Shares, to the extent their Award has Vested, at a price (which may be zero) set when the Option is granted; or</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="color:#000058;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#45;</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;"><font style="font-family:Arial;color:#000000;">Forfeitable Shares - Awards under which the Participant receives free Shares on grant which are subject to a requirement that the Participant gives the Shares back to the extent the Award lapses.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Conditional Awards and Options can also be granted on the basis that they will only ever be satisfied with a cash payment equal to the value of the Shares to which the Participant would otherwise be entitled (less any Option Price).</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Awards will Vest over a period set by the Directors for each Award and Vesting or grant may be subject to Performance Conditions or other conditions. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">After Vesting, Awards may also be subject to a Retention Period.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:15.59%;text-indent:-7.8%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">This introduction does not form part of the rules.</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><a name="_Toc505264894"></a><a name="_Ref505265206"></a><a name="_Toc407612719"></a><a name="_Toc407612751"></a><a name="_Toc407612818"></a><a name="_Toc407612907"></a><a name="_Toc407612967"></a>Definitions</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In these rules:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Acquiring Company</font>&#8221; means a person who has or obtains Control of the Company;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Additional Shares</font>&#8221; has the meaning set out in rule 6.3;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Award</font>&#8221; means a Conditional Award, Forfeitable Shares or an Option; </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Award Date</font>&#8221; means the date on which an Award is granted under rule4;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Bonus Deferral Award</font>&#8221; means a Time-based Award which is granted to the Participant in lieu of bonus which he might otherwise have been paid in cash and which is designated as such by the Directors under rule 3.3.2;<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top"> </sup></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Business Day</font>&#8221; means a day on which the London Stock Exchange is open for the transaction of business;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Company</font>&#8221; means Rio Tinto plc;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Conditional Award</font>&#8221; means a conditional right to acquire Shares for free granted under the Plan;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Consideration Point</font>&#8221; means the earlier of:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(i)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">such time as the Directors considers that the outcome and/or significance of any internal or external investigation, actions or other events or circumstances is fully understood;</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(ii)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">any date on which Vesting would otherwise occur under rules 13.1 (Takeover) or 13.3 (Demerger or other corporate event); and</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(iii)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">such earlier time which the Directors may in its absolute discretion determine</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU4"></a><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">but not later than the fifth anniversary of the date on which the Award would have Vested but for the postponement o</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">f such Vesting under r</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">ule 9 (Suspension);</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Control</font>&#8221; has the meaning given to it in Section 995 of the Income Tax Act 2007;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Corporate Event</font>&#8221; means, in relation to the Company: </p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(i)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">any demerger, delisting, distribution (other than an ordinary dividend) or other transaction, which, in the opinion of the Directors, might affect the current or future value of Shares; or</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(ii)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">any reverse takeover (not being a change in Control of the Company), merger by way of a dual listed company or other significant corporate event, as determined by the Directors;</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Dealing Restrictions</font>&#8221; means any restriction on dealing in securities imposed by regulation, statute, order, directive, the rules of any stock exchange on which Shares are listed or any code adopted by the Company as varied from time to time;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Detrimental Activity</font>&#8221; means, as established to the satisfaction of the Directors, and without the prior written consent of the Company, the Participant being in breach of any applicable restrictions on competition, solicitation or the use of confidential information (whether arising out of the Participant&#8217;s employment contract, their termination arrangements or any internal policies);</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Directors</font>&#8221; means, subject to rule 13.5, the remuneration committee of the board of directors of the Company or any other committee comprised of non-executive directors of the board of the Company or any other person to whom any such committee has delegated any of its functions under these rules;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Dividend Equivalent</font>&#8221; means a conditional entitlement to an amount linked to Dividends;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Dividends</font>&#8221; in relation to a particular Award, means dividends on Shares (excluding any non-ordinary dividend which the Directors determine should be excluded) the record date for which was within the period between the Award Date and the day before the date on which those Shares are registered in the name of the relevant Participant (both dates inclusive);</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Exco</font>&#8221; means the executive committee of the Company;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Final Lapse Date</font>&#8221; means the latest date on which an Option will lapse which will be the date set by the Directors under rule 3.3.8 or, if no date is set, the date 10 years after the Award Date;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Forfeitable Share Agreement</font>&#8221; means the agreement referred to in the Schedule 1 to these rules;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Forfeitable Shares</font>&#8221; means Shares held in the name of or for the benefit of a Participant subject to the Forfeitable Share Agreement; </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Grantor</font>&#8221; means the Company or any other entity which grants or has agreed with the Company to satisfy an Award under the Plan; </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Group</font>&#8221; means the Company, Subsidiaries and any other company which is associated with the Company and is so designated by the Directors for some or all purposes of the Plan and &#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Member of the Group</font>&#8221; shall be construed accordingly;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU5"></a><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;</font><font style="font-weight:bold;">London </font><font style="font-weight:bold;">Stock</font><font style="font-weight:bold;"> Exchange</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8221; means London </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Stock</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> Exchange plc</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> or any successor</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Option</font>&#8221; means a conditional right to acquire Shares by the exercise of that right granted under the Plan;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Option Price</font>&#8221; means the amount (which may be zero) payable on the exercise of an Option set by the Directors under rule 3.3.8;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Owned Shares</font>&#8221; means Shares subject to a Retention Period which are transferred or issued into the beneficial ownership of the Participant as set out in rule 7.1.1(i);</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Participant</font>&#8221; means a person who holds, or who has held, an Award or their personal representatives;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Performance</font> <font style="font-weight:bold;">Condition</font>&#8221; means any condition linked to performance imposed under rule 3.3.5; </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Performance-based Award</font>&#8221; means an Award as so designated by the Directors under rule 3.3.2;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Plan</font>&#8221; means these rules known as &#8220;The Rio Tinto plc Equity Incentive Plan 2018&#8221;, as changed from time to time;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Retention Period</font>&#8221; means the period after Vesting during which a Participant is required to retain their Shares as set out in rule 7;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Retention Shares</font>&#8221; means any Vested Shares and any Additional Shares which the Participant is required to retain during the Retention Period;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Review Period</font>&#8221; means, in relation to a particular Award, a period of two years following the Vesting of that Award except where rule 11.2.5 applies; </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Rio Tinto Group</font>&#8221; means each Member of the Group and Rio Tinto Limited and its subsidiaries;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Shares</font>&#8221; means fully paid ordinary shares the Company;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Subsidiary</font>&#8221; means a body corporate in which is a subsidiary of the Company within the meaning of Section 1159 of the Companies Act 2006; and</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Time-based Award</font>&#8221; means an Award as so designated by the Directors under rule 3.3.2;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Vesting</font>&#8221;, subject to the rules:</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">3.4</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref369008844"></a>Performance Conditions</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Directors may decide that Vesting of an Award will be conditional:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">3.4.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">on the satisfaction of one or more conditions set by the Directors on grant linked to the performance of the Company, the Participant and/or any business unit or Member of the Group; and/or</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">3.4.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">any other condition or conditions set by the Directors,</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">which, in either case, may provide that the Award will lapse to the extent that it is not satisfied.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Directors may amend a Performance Condition in accordance with its terms or if anything happens which causes the Directors reasonably to consider the amended Performance Condition would be a fairer measure of performance. The Directors may waive or change any other condition in such manner as it sees fit.</p>

<td valign="top">

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">A Participant may not transfer, assign, charge or otherwise dispose of an Award or any rights in respect of it nor use an Award or any Shares subject to an Award as collateral for a loan or in any other context. If they do, whether voluntarily or involuntarily, then the Award will immediately lapse. This rule 5.2 does not apply:</p>

Any Shares, securities or rights allotted to a Participant as a result of such an event will be:</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><a name="_Ref368996568"></a><a name="_Toc407612723"></a><a name="_Toc407612755"></a><a name="_Toc407612822"></a><a name="_Toc407612911"></a><a name="_Toc407612971"></a><a name="_Toc505264898"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU9"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Vesting</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">6.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref369079886"></a>Timing and extent of Vesting </p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Subject to the rest of these rules, an Award will Vest on the later of the following:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">6.1.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">the Vesting Date; and</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">6.1.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><a name="_Ref409701216"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">the date on which the Directors determine the extent to which any Performance Condition or any other condition is satisfied.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Award will only Vest to the extent that any Performance Condition or other condition is satisfied.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">However, if Vesting or the issue or transfer of Shares in satisfaction of an Award is prevented by any Dealing Restriction, the period for Vesting, issue or transfer will be delayed for that Award until the Dealing Restriction no longer prevents it.</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">6.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Toc213663682"></a><a name="_Toc213664492"></a><a name="_Toc213664707"></a><a name="_Toc213664826"></a><a name="_Toc213665006"></a><a name="_Toc215978128"></a><a name="_Toc215978407"></a><a name="_Ref369079274"></a>Consequences of Vesting</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">6.2.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><a name="_Ref409701251"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">If an Award takes the form of a Conditional Award, within 30 days of Vesting (or as soon as reasonably practicable after that), the Grantor will arrange (subject to the rest of this rule 6 and rules 7, 9, 10, 15 and 17.6) for the issue or transfer to, or to the order of, the Participant of the number of Shares in respect of which the Award has Vested.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">6.2.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><a name="_Ref403506017"></a><a name="_Ref370218320"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">A Participant can only exercise an Option to the extent it has Vested. To exercise it, the Participant must give notice in such form as the Grantor may prescribe and, in the case of an Option, comply with such arrangements as the Grantor determines for the payment of the Option Price (if any) including, without limitation, the sale of sufficient Shares to procure the payment of the Option Price. Subject to the rest of this rule 6 and rules 7, 9, 10, 15 and 17.6, the Grantor will arrange for the number of Shares in respect of which an Option has been exercised to be issued or transferred to the Participant within 30 days of the date on which the Option is exercised or as soon as reasonably practicable after that. An Option will lapse at the end of business on the Final Lapse Date if it does not lapse earlier under these rules.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
