<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(d)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU20"></a>for the avoidance of doubt, a time pro-rated reduction under this rule will not apply to a Bonus Deferral Award at all or, unless the Directors decide </p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">17</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap"></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">otherwise, </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">to a Performance</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">-based</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> Award where the takeover occurs on or after the third anniversary of the Award Date.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.1.3</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">To the extent that an Award has not Vested, it will lapse as to the balance, unless exchanged under rule 13.4 (Exchange of Awards). </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.1.4</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">An Option will be exercisable for a period of one month</font><font style="font-size:10pt;"> </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">from the date of the takeover, after which it will lapse (whether or not it Vested under this rule).</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.1.5</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><a name="_Ref158542273"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">An Award will not Vest under rule 13.1.1 but will be exchanged under rule 13.4 (Exchange of Awards) if:</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(i)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">an offer to exchange Awards is made and accepted by a Participant; or</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(ii)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">the Directors, with the consent of the Acquiring Company, decides before the person obtains Control that the Awards will be automatically exchanged.</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_Ref158006412"></a>There is a <font style="font-weight:bold;">&#8220;takeover&#8221;</font> when:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(i)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">a person (or a group of persons acting in concert) obtains Control of the Company whether or not as a result of making an offer to acquire Shares; or</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(ii)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">under Section 899 of the Companies Act 2006, a court sanctions a compromise or arrangement in connection with the acquisition of Shares,</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">but not where the Directors determines rule 13.2 (Reconstruction) applies.</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref468304323"></a>Reconstruction</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">If there is any internal reconstruction, reorganisation, merger or acquisition of the Company which:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.2.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">is not intended to result in; or </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.2.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">does not involve </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">a significant change in the identity of the ultimate shareholders of the Company then the Directors may determine this rule 13.2 applies to any Awards which have not Vested by the day the reconstruction takes effect. The Directors will arrange for an Award to be replaced by an equivalent award of shares in the new parent company or companies as determined by the Directors. The Directors may amend any Performance Condition as it considers appropriate.</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.3</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref158103917"></a>Demerger or Other Corporate Event</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.3.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><a name="_Ref468304978"></a><a name="_Ref158541342"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">If the Directors becomes aware that the Company is or is expected to be affected by any demerger, distribution (other than an ordinary dividend), reconstruction or other transaction not falling within rule 13.1 (Takeover) which, in the opinion of the Directors, would affect the current or future value of any Award, the Directors may allow an Award to Vest (subject to rule 9 (Suspension) and rule 10 (Malus)) subject to any such conditions as the Directors may decide to impose. </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.3.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">Where rule 13.3.1 applies: </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(a)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU21"></a>the Directors will determine the extent to which any Performance Condition has been satisfied to the date of the Vesting determined under rule 13.3.1 in accordance with its terms or, if they do not provide for it, in such manner </p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">18</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap"></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">as it considers reasonable</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">, </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">and the proportion of the Award which will Vest</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">as a result;</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(b)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">unless the Directors decide otherwise, and except in the case of a Bonus Deferral Award or a Performance-based Award, the number of Shares in respect of which the Award would otherwise Vest under rule 13.3.1 will be reduced by the proportion which the number of complete days from the date of Vesting under rule 13.3.1 to the Vesting Date bears to the number of complete days in the period from the Award Date to the Vesting Date; </p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(c)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">unless the Directors decide otherwise, in the case of a Performance-based Award where the Vesting under rule 13.3.1 occurs before the third anniversary of the Award Date, the number of Shares in respect of which the Award would otherwise Vest under rule 13.3.1 will be reduced by the proportion which the number of complete days from the date of Vesting under rule 13.3.1 to the third anniversary of the Award Date bears to the number of complete days in the period from the Award Date to the third anniversary of the Award Date; and</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(d)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">for the avoidance of doubt, a time pro-rated reduction under this rule will not apply to a Bonus Deferral Award at all or unless the Directors decide otherwise, to a Performance-based Award where the takeover occurs on or after the third anniversary of the Award Date.</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">

<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">To the extent that an Award has not Vested, it will lapse as to the balance. </font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.3.4</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">The Directors will determine the period during which an Option may be exercised under this rule 13.3 (whether or not it Vested under rule 13.3.1) and whether or not it will lapse at the end of that period.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.3.5</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">Participants will be notified if they are affected by the Directors exercising their discretion under this rule.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref468304793"></a><a name="_Ref468305183"></a>Exchange of Awards</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">If an Award is to be exchanged under this rule 13, the exchange will take place as soon as practicable after the relevant event.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The new award:</p>
<div align="left">

<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">

<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.4.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><a name="_Ref158104372"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">must confer a right to acquire shares in the Acquiring Company or another body corporate determined by the Acquiring Company;</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">will be treated as having been acquired at the same time as the existing Award and, subject to rule 13.4.4, will Vest in the same manner and at the same time;</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><a name="_Ref158104155"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">must either:</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">be subject to a Performance Condition which is, so far as practicable, equivalent to any Performance Condition applying to the existing Award; or</p></td></tr></table></div>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU22"></a><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">be subject to such other terms as the </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Directors</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> considers appropriate in all the circumstances; and</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;">Directors&#8217; powers</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Except as described in the rest of this rule 14, the Directors may at any time change the Plan including the terms of any Award already granted in any way.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company, any employing company or trustee of any employee benefit trust, may withhold any amounts or make such arrangements as it considers necessary to meet any liability to pay or account for any such taxation or social security contributions, other levies or any deductions required under the Rio Tinto Group&#8217;s policies on hypothetical taxes. These arrangements may include the sale of or reduction in number of Shares to which a Participant would otherwise be entitled or the deduction of the amount of the liability from any cash amount payable to the Participant under the Plan or otherwise.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Participant will promptly do all things necessary to facilitate such arrangements and, notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the Plan, Vesting or the issue or transfer of Shares may be delayed until he does so.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">An Award must not be granted if the number of Shares committed to be issued under that Award exceeds 10 per cent of the ordinary share capital of the Company in issue immediately before that day, when added to the number of Shares which have been issued, or committed to be issued, to satisfy Awards under the Plan, or options or awards under any other employee share plan operated by the Company, granted or awarded in the previous 10 years.</p>

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU24"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">which </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">are</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;"> committed to be issued under any Dividend Equivalent</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;"> but will count towards such limits on their issuance</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">As long as so required by institutional shareholders, Shares transferred from treasury are counted as part of the ordinary share capital of the Company, and as Shares issued by the Company. </p>

<div align="left">

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref175567920"></a>Terms of employment</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">17.1.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">This rule 17.1 applies during an employee&#8217;s employment with a Member of the Group and after the termination of an employee&#8217;s employment, whether or not the termination is lawful.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">17.1.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">Nothing in the rules or the operation of the Plan forms part of the contract of employment of an employee. The rights and obligations arising from the employment relationship between the employee and their employer are separate from, and are not affected by, the Plan. Participation in the Plan does not create any right to, or expectation of, continued employment.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">

<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">No employee has a right to participate in the Plan. Participation in the Plan or the grant of Awards on a particular basis in any year does not create any right to or expectation of participation in the Plan or the grant of Awards on the same basis, or at all, in any future year.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<div align="left">

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">The employee will have no claim or right of action in respect of any decision, omission or discretion, which may operate to the disadvantage of the employee (including, without limitation, any adjustment under rule 9</font><font style="font-size:10pt;"> </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">or rule 10) even if it is unreasonable, irrational or might otherwise be regarded as being in breach of the duty of trust and confidence (and/or any other implied duty) between the employee and their employer.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">The basis for any processing of personal information about a Participant who is subject to the EU&#8217;s General Data Protection Regulation (2016/679) (or any successor laws) is set out in the Company&#8217;s Share Plan Privacy Notice and is not the consent given under rule 17.5.2.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Share Plan Privacy Notice also contains details about how the Participant&#8217;s personal information is processed and the Participant&#8217;s rights in relation to that information. <p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">24</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_Toc505264910"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU27"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Schedule</font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> 1</font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> </font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Grant of Forfeitable Shares</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Where an Award takes the form of Forfeitable Shares, the Participant must:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">enter into an agreement with the Grantor that, to the extent that the Award lapses under the Plan, the Shares are forfeited and they will immediately transfer their interest in them, for no consideration or nominal consideration, to any person (which may include the Company, where permitted) specified by the Grantor;</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">complete any elections required by the Directors, including elections under Part 7 of the Income Tax (Earnings and Pensions) Act 2003 (or similar elections in other jurisdictions) and elections to transfer any liability, or agreements to pay social security contributions; and</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">3</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">provide any other documentation which the Directors consider necessary or desirable to give effect to the terms of the Award, including a power of attorney or blank stock transfer form.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">If the Participant does not do any of the actions above within a period specified by the Directors, the Award will lapse at the end of that period. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On or after the grant of Forfeitable Shares, the Grantor will procure that the relevant number of Shares are issued or transferred to the Participant or to another person to be held for the benefit of the Participant under the terms of the Plan. Where applicable, the share certificates or other documents of title relating to any Forfeitable Shares may be retained by the Grantor.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><br /></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">25</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_Toc505264911"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU28"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Schedule</font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> 2</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Cash Awards</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Rules of the Rio Tinto plc Equity Incentive Plan 2018 will apply to a right (a &#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Cash Award</font>&#8221;) to receive a cash sum granted or to be granted under this Schedule as if it was a Conditional Award or an Option, except as set out in this Schedule. Where there is any conflict between the Rules and this Schedule, the terms of this Schedule will prevail.</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">The Directors may grant or procure the grant of a Cash Award and designate it as a Conditional Award or an Option.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">Each Cash Award will relate to a given number of notional Shares.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">3</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">On the Vesting or exercise of the Cash Award the holder of that Award will be entitled to a cash sum which will be equal to the &#8220;</font><font style="font-size:10pt;">Cash Value</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">&#8221; of the notional Vested Shares, where the Cash Value of a notional Share is the market value of a Share on the date of Vesting or exercise of the Cash Award as determined by the Directors.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">4</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">The cash sum payable under paragraph 3 above will be paid by the employer of the Participant (or any other Member of the Group as the Directors decide) as soon as practicable after the Vesting or exercise of the Cash Award, net of any deductions (on account of tax, hypothetical tax or similar liabilities) as may be required by law or as required under the Rio Tinto Group&#8217;s policies on hypothetical taxes.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">For the avoidance of doubt, a Cash Award will not confer any right on the holder of such an Award to receive Shares or any interest in Shares.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><br /></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">26</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_Toc505264912"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU29"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Schedule 3</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">France</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The purpose of this schedule is to make certain variations to the terms of the Plan, in order to satisfy French securities laws, exchange control, corporate law and tax requirements (especially the provisions of Article 80 quaterdecies of the French tax code and Articles L. 225-197-1 et seq. of the French Code de commerce with respect to free shares and Article 80 bis III of the French tax code and Articles L. 225-177 of the French Code of Commerce with respect to stock options) to qualify for favourable income tax and social security treatments in France.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The rules of the Plan, as amended by this schedule, are based on the above-mentioned provisions of the French Code of Commerce (in force on the date when the Plan was adopted), subject to any subsequent change or provision required by legislation, regulations or interpretations thereof. Consequently, the rules of the Plan, as amended by this schedule will be applied and may be amended in accordance with such legislation, regulations and interpretations. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In case of contradiction between (i) the Plan and/or the Award letter and (ii) the French Code of Commerce and/or the statement of practice of the French tax authorities, the French Code of Commerce and the statement of practice of the French tax authorities shall prevail.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">These rules are based on the assumption that the Shares are listed on a regulated stock exchange.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The rules of the Plan shall apply subject to the modifications contained in this Schedule 3 whenever the Directors decide to grant a qualifying Award to a French tax resident Participant under this Schedule 3. The Directors may still decide to grant, to a French tax resident, Awards which terms and conditions may vary from this Schedule 3. Should that be the case, the Awards shall clearly indicate that they may not comply with this Schedule 3 and that they may not be qualifying for a favourable treatment under French tax and social security law.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Information in square brackets is for information purposes.</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><a name="_Toc505264913"></a>Rule 1 Introduction</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">No Forfeitable Shares shall be granted under this Schedule 3. Any reference in the Plan to Forfeitable Shares shall be deleted accordingly.</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><a name="_Toc505264914"></a>Rule 2 Definitions</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><font style="font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;">The definitions of &#8220;Subsidiary&#8221; &#8220;Participant&#8221; and &#8220;Option Price&#8221; stated in rule 2 of the Plan shall be deleted and replaced by the following definitions:</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Subsidiary</font>&#8221; means (i) a company in which the Company holds, directly or indirectly, at least 10 per cent of the share capital or voting rights; (ii) a company holding directly or indirectly at least 10 per cent of the share capital or voting rights of the Company; or (iii) a company for which at least 50 per cent of the share capital or voting rights are held by a company which holds at least 50 per cent of the share capital of the Company. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Participant</font>&#8221; means a salaried employee of the Company or any Subsidiary, or a corporate officer of the Company or any Subsidiary holding the duties of chairman of the board, general manager, deputy general manager, member of the directory board, or manager (respectively <font style="font-style:italic;">pr&#233;sident du conseil d&#8217;administration, directeur g&#233;n&#233;ral, directeur g&#233;n&#233;ral d&#233;l&#233;gu&#233;, membre du directoire </font>or<font style="font-style:italic;"> g&#233;rant</font>). </p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">27</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU30"></a><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;</font><font style="font-weight:bold;">Option Price</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8221; means an acquisition price which cannot be less than 80% of the average share price of the twenty trading sessions preceding the day of granting of such Option, provided that no Option can be granted within twenty trading sessions following a dividend payment or a capital increase. The acquisition price of share shall also not be lower than 80% of the price referred to in Article L. 225-179 &#167;2 of the French Code of Commerce. </font></p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><font style="font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;">For the purpose of Awards granted under this Schedule 3, the following new definitions shall be added to those stated in rule 1 of the Plan:</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Closed Period</font>&#8221; means:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">With respect to Conditional Awards, (i) the 10 trading days preceding and 3 trading days following the date on which the Company&#8217;s consolidated accounts or, failing that, the annual accounts, are made public; and (ii) the period between (x) the date on which the management bodies of the Company have knowledge of information which, if made public, could have a significant impact on the price of the Shares and (y) the end of the tenth trading day following the date on which this information has been made public; and</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">With respect to Options, (i) the 10 trading days preceding and following the date on which the Company&#8217;s consolidated accounts or, failing that, the annual accounts, are made public; and (ii) the period between (x) the date on which the management bodies of the Company have knowledge of information which, if made public, could have a significant impact on the price of the Shares and (y) the end of the tenth trading day following the date on which this information has been made public. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Defined Disability</font>&#8221; means the circumstance where a Participant is recognised as a disabled employee of the second or third category under the meaning of Article L.341-4 of the French Social Security Code.&#8221;</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2.3</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><font style="font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;">The definition of &#8220;</font><font style="font-size:10pt;">Vesting Date</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;">&#8220; shall be supplemented as follows: With respect to Conditional Award, the Vesting Date shall not occur less than one year after the grant of the Award.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><font style="font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;">All capitalised terms used in this Schedule 3 and not otherwise defined herein shall have the meaning ascribed to them in the Plan.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">3</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><a name="_Toc505264915"></a>Rule 3 (Granting Awards)</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">3.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><font style="font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;">Rule 3.1 (Eligibility) shall be supplemented with the following provisions:</font><font style="font-size:10pt;"> </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;A grant of Awards shall comply with specific conditions when allocating Awards to corporate officers/directors: </p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;Shares transferred to Participants holding the duties of chairman of the board, general manager, deputy general manager, member of the directory board, or manager (respectively <font style="font-style:italic;">pr&#233;sident du conseil d&#8217;administration, directeur g&#233;n&#233;ral, directeur g&#233;n&#233;ral d&#233;l&#233;gu&#233;, membre du directoire or g&#233;rant</font>) in the Company or any Member of the Group shall not be disposed before termination of the Participant&#8217;s executive duties. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Alternatively, the Directors may decide that a fraction of the Shares transferred to Participants holding the duties of chairman of the board, general manager, deputy general manager, member of the directory board, or manager (respectively <font style="font-style:italic;">pr&#233;sident du conseil d&#8217;administration, directeur g&#233;n&#233;ral, directeur g&#233;n&#233;ral d&#233;l&#233;gu&#233;, membre du directoire or g&#233;rant</font>) in the Company or any Member of the Group will be in a registered (<font style="font-style:italic;">nominatif</font>) form and will not be available for sale or transfer before termination of the Participant&#8217;s executive duties.&#8221; </p>

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><font style="font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;">Rule 8.5 (Death) shall be renamed &#8220;Death and Defined Disability&#8221; and replaced with the following provisions:</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_Hlk504668581"></a>&#8220;Notwithstanding any other rule of the Plan, where a Participant leaves employment for reason of death, his/hers heirs may require, within six (6) months from the date of death, Vesting of the deceased&#8217;s Conditional <a name="_Hlk504668581"></a>Award and the transfer of the underlying Shares. The Shares will be transferred to the heirs of the Participant as soon as practicably possible following their request, and shall not be subject to any Retention Period. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Notwithstanding any other rule of the Plan, where a Participant suffers from a Defined Disability, he/she can request at any time the Vesting of its Conditional Award and the transfer of the underlying Shares. Shares transferred to a Participant suffering from a Defined Disability shall not be subject to any Retention Period.&#8221; </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;Notwithstanding any other rule of the Plan, where a Participant leaves employment for reason of death, his/hers heirs may require, within six (6) months from the date of death, Vesting and the exercise of the deceased&#8217;s Options. The Shares will be transferred to the heirs of the Participant as soon as practicably possible following the exercise, and shall not be subject to any Retention Period.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Specific restrictions for listed companies under Article L225-197-6 of the French Code of Commerce are also applicable, including with respect to Conditional Awards allocation to directors (<font style="font-style:italic;">dirigeants</font>) of the French Subsidiaries and French branches of foreign companies. These restrictions shall be construed in compliance with the statements of practice BOI-RSA-20-20-10-10-20170724 and BOI-RSA-20-20-10-20-20170724, as amended and/or supplemented from time to time.&#8221;</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Individual limits provided under Article L225-182 of the French Code of Commerce and global limits provided under Article L225-182 and Article R225-145 of the French Code of Commerce are applicable to Options.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Specific restrictions for listed companies under Article L225-186-1 of the French Code of Commerce are also applicable,</p>

<td valign="top">

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><font style="font-weight:normal;font-size:10pt;">Rule 16 shall be supplemented with the following provisions:</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;16.11 form of Shares</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">16.11.1 Options:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In accordance with Article 80 bis II bis of the French tax code, after exercise of the Options, the Shares must be held in registered form in the name of the participant; the conversion of a Share into bearer form is assimilated to a sale. Pursuant to the statement of practice BOI-RSA-ES-20-10-10-20140812 &#167;390, it is also possible, since the Shares are Shares in a non-French company, to comply with such requirement in segregating these Shares in a specific blocked account if foreign legislation does not permit to hold the Shares in a registered form.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">16.11.2 Condition Awards</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In accordance with Article 80 quaterdecies II of the French tax code, the conversion of a Share into bearer form is assimilated to a sale.&#8221;</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">16.12.1 Condition Awards</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company and its Subsidiaries will comply with the information obligations provided under Article L225-197-4 of the French Code of Commerce and under the statement of practice BOI-RSA-ES-20-20-10-20-20170724 &#167;480.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">16.12.2 Options</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company and its Subsidiaries will comply with the information obligations provided under Article L225-184 of the French Code of Commerce.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">32</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU35"></a><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The employer of a</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> Participant </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">shall comply with the </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">provisions of Article L.242-1 of the French Social Security Code</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> and shall provide the relevant information to </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">the social security authorities</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">.</font></p>
