<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company and its Subsidiaries are entitled to provide all relevant information to any tax or social security authorities with respect to a Participant and the Plan. The Participant shall cooperate with the Company and its Subsidiaries as the case may be.&#8221;</p>

<p style="text-align:right;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:0pt;;text-indent:0pt;;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">26</p></td>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:0%;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">i</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><a name="_Toc213663640"></a><a name="_Toc213664488"></a><a name="_Toc213664703"></a><a name="_Toc213664822"></a><a name="_Toc213665002"></a><a name="_Toc215978124"></a><a name="_Toc215978403"></a><a name="_Toc407612718"></a><a name="_Toc407612750"></a><a name="_Toc407612817"></a><a name="_Toc407612906"></a><a name="_Toc407612966"></a><a name="_Toc506366211"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU3"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Introduction</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Plan allows for the grant of Awards in the form of:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="color:#000058;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#45;</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;"><font style="font-family:Arial;color:#000000;">Conditional Awards - Awards under which the Participant receives Shares for free automatically to the extent the Award Vests;</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="color:#000058;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#45;</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;"><font style="font-family:Arial;color:#000000;">Options - Awards under which the Participant can acquire Shares, to the extent their Award has Vested, at a price (which may be zero) set when the Option is granted; or</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="color:#000058;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#45;</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;color:#000058;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;"><font style="font-family:Arial;color:#000000;">Forfeitable Shares - Awards under which the Participant receives free Shares on grant which are subject to a requirement that the Participant gives the Shares back to the extent the Award lapses.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Conditional Awards and Options can also be granted on the basis that they will only ever be satisfied with a cash payment equal to the value of the Shares to which the Participant would otherwise be entitled (less any Option Price).</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Awards will Vest over a period set by the Directors for each Award and Vesting or grant may be subject to Performance Conditions or other conditions. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">After Vesting, Awards may also be subject to a Retention Period.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:15.59%;text-indent:-7.8%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">This introduction does not form part of the rules.</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><a name="_Ref505265206"></a><a name="_Toc506366212"></a><a name="_Toc407612719"></a><a name="_Toc407612751"></a><a name="_Toc407612818"></a><a name="_Toc407612907"></a><a name="_Toc407612967"></a>Definitions</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In these rules:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Acquiring Company</font>&#8221; means a person who has or obtains Control of the Company;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Additional Shares</font>&#8221; has the meaning set out in rule 6.3;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Associated Body Corporate</font>&#8221; means;</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(i)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">a body corporate that is a related body corporate of the Company within the meaning of Section 50 of the Corporations Act;</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(ii)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">a body corporate that has Voting Power in the Company of not less than 20%; or</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(iii)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Owned Shares</font>&#8221; means Shares subject to a Retention Period which are transferred or issued into the beneficial ownership of the Participant as set out in rule 7.1.1(i);</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Participant</font>&#8221; means a person who holds, or who has held, an Award or their personal representatives;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Performance</font> <font style="font-weight:bold;">Condition</font>&#8221; means any condition linked to performance imposed under rule 3.3.5; </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Performance-based Award</font>&#8221; means an Award as so designated by the Directors under rule 3.3.2;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Plan</font>&#8221; means these rules known as &#8220;The Rio Tinto Limited Equity Incentive Plan 2018&#8221;, as changed from time to time;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Retention Period</font>&#8221; means the period after Vesting during which a Participant is required to retain their Shares as set out in rule 7;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Retention Shares</font>&#8221; means any Vested Shares and any Additional Shares which the Participant is required to retain during the Retention Period;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Review Period</font>&#8221; means, in relation to a particular Award, a period of two years following the Vesting of that Award except where rule 11.2.5 applies; </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Rio Tinto Group</font>&#8221; means each Member of the Group and Rio Tinto plc and its subsidiaries;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Shares</font>&#8221; means fully paid ordinary shares the Company;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">3</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU6"></a><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;</font><font style="font-weight:bold;">Subsidiary</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8221; </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">means a body corporate </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">in </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">which is a subsidiary of the </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Company</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> within the meaning of Section </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">46</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">of the </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Corporation</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">s</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Act;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Time-based Award</font>&#8221; means an Award as so designated by the Directors under rule 3.3.2;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Vesting</font>&#8221;, subject to the rules:</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Vesting Date</font>&#8221; means the date set for Vesting of an Award under rule 3.3.6; and</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">If there is any conflict between two provisions in these rules under which an Award will lapse, the one which gives rise to the earlier lapse will prevail.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">which, in either case, may provide that the Award will lapse to the extent that it is not satisfied.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Directors may amend a Performance Condition in accordance with its terms or if anything happens which causes the Directors reasonably to consider the amended Performance Condition would be a fairer measure of performance. The Directors may waive or change any other condition in such manner as it sees fit.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">The number of Shares subject to a Deferred Bonus Award will be determined on the basis set out in the relevant short term incentive plan and in accordance with any relevant remuneration policy.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">A Participant is not required to pay for the grant of an Award.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref379919306"></a>Conditional Awards and Options</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">An Award (other than an Award of Forfeitable Shares) will be granted by a Directors&#8217; resolution.</p>

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;">Voting and dividends</p></td></tr></table></div>

<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">5.1.1</font></p></td>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">A Participant is not entitled to vote, to receive dividends or to have any other rights of a shareholder in respect of Shares subject to an Option or a Conditional Award until the Shares are issued or transferred to the Participant.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">A Participant may not transfer, assign, charge or otherwise dispose of an Award or any rights in respect of it nor use an Award or any Shares subject to an Award as collateral for a loan or in any other context. If they do, whether voluntarily or involuntarily, then the Award will immediately lapse. This rule 5.2 does not apply:</p>

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref84218232"></a>Dividend Equivalent</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_Ref84218244"></a>Except in the case of a Participant who is granted an Option with an Option Price set at market value at grant, a Participant will be entitled on the issue or transfer of Vested Shares on or following the Vesting of a Conditional Award or the exercise of an Option to a number of additional Shares (&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Additional Shares</font>&#8221;) calculated on the basis set out below, unless the Directors decide to use a different basis:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:15.59%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">X = D / P<font style="font-weight:normal;">, rounded down to the nearest whole number, where:</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:15.59%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">X<font style="font-weight:normal;"> is the number of Additional Shares;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:15.59%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">D<font style="font-weight:normal;"> is the aggregate cash amount of all Dividends which would have been paid to the relevant Participant in respect of the number of Vested Shares if that number of Shares had been registered in the name of the Participant on the Award Date, excluding any imputed or associated tax credits or rebates, such as Australian franking credits;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:15.59%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">P<font style="font-weight:normal;"> is the average of the closing price of Shares on the Australian Securities Exchange over the five Business Days ending on the Business Day before the Vesting of the Award, or such other date as the Directors decide.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_Ref286919039"></a>If the Directors so decide and regulatory requirements permit, the amount payable under this rule may be satisfied in cash. In this instance, the amount payable is equal to <font style="font-weight:bold;">D</font>.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">For the avoidance of doubt, where there has been an adjustment in the number of Shares subject to an Award pursuant to rule 5.3, then for the purposes of calculating D in the formula above, the value of any Dividends which had a record date falling (i) before the date of the adjustment will be calculated by reference to the number of shares under the Award on the Award Date before the adjustment and (ii) after the date of adjustment will be based on the revised number of Shares under the Award which resulted from the adjustment.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Where tax is payable at the start of the Retention Period, then rule 15 (Tax) will apply and the Retention Period will apply in respect of the remainder of the Retention Shares. Shares may be issued or transferred and sold to the extent necessary to satisfy the liability under that rule.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><a name="_Ref379920493"></a><a name="_Toc407612725"></a><a name="_Toc407612757"></a><a name="_Toc407612824"></a><a name="_Toc407612913"></a><a name="_Toc407612973"></a><a name="_Toc506366218"></a>Leaving employment </p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref498531892"></a>General rule on leaving employment</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Unless rule 8.2 applies, if a Participant leaves employment (defined below) before their Award Vests then their Award will not lapse but will Vest in accordance with the provisions of this rule 8.</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref50279916"></a>Leaving in specific circumstances</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_Ref50279956"></a><a name="_Ref66864758"></a>If a Participant leaves employment by reason of:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.2.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><a name="_Ref90368693"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">resignation; </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.2.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">dismissal arising from misconduct (including if a Participant ceases employment following notice from their employer of proposed termination as a result of misconduct);</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.2.3</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">any other reason, if the Directors so decide in any particular case,</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">then their Award will lapse, unless the Directors in their absolute discretion decide otherwise, and in exercising this discretion the Directors can determine the extent to which an Award Vests and any terms on which the Award will Vest and any Option may be exercised.</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.3</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref498520221"></a><a name="_Ref368990295"></a>Timing of Vesting</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Where rule 8.1 applies:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.3.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">a Performance-based Award will Vest on the date it would have Vested if the Participant had not left employment unless the Directors decide at any time that the Award will Vest earlier;</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.3.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">a Time-based Award will Vest on the date of leaving employment unless the Directors decide at any time that the Award will vest on a later date; and</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.3.3</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><a name="_Ref498520733"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">any Time-based Award, including any Bonus Deferral Award, held by a member of the ExCo will Vest on the date it would have Vested if the Participant had not left employment unless rule 8.5 applies.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.4</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref409700153"></a><a name="_Ref369532186"></a><a name="_Ref369080758"></a>Extent of Vesting of Award</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Where rule 8.1 applies: </p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.4.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">the Award will Vest to the extent any Performance Condition is satisfied on the date of Vesting and if an Award Vests earlier than the Vesting Date the Directors will determine the extent to which any Performance Condition is satisfied in accordance with its terms or, if there are no such terms, in such manner as they consider reasonable; </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.4.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><a name="_Ref473930627"></a><a name="_Ref498515067"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU14"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">unless the Directors decide otherwise, and except in the case of a Bonus Deferral Award or a Performance-based Award, the number of Shares in respect of which the Award would otherwise Vest will be reduced by the proportion which the </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">11</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap"></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">number of </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">complete </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">days </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">from </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">the date </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">the Participant left employment </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">to</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;"> the</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;"> </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">Vesting Date</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;"> bears to</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;"> the number of </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">complete </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">days</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;"> in </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">the period </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">from the Award Date to the </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">Vesting Date</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">;</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;"> </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.4.3</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">unless the Directors decide otherwise, in the case of a Performance-based Award where the Participant leaves employment before the third anniversary of the Award Date, the number of Shares in respect of which the Award would otherwise Vest will be reduced by the proportion which the number of complete days from the date the Participant left employment to the third anniversary of the Award Date bears to the number of complete days in the period from the Award Date to the third anniversary of the Award Date; and</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.4.4</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">for the avoidance of doubt, a time pro-rated reduction under this rule will not apply to a Bonus Deferral Award at all or, unless the Directors decide otherwise, to a Performance-based Award where the Participant leaves employment on or after the third anniversary of the Award Date.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.5</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref498520745"></a><a name="_Ref243295232"></a><a name="_Ref52264594"></a>Death</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">If a Participant dies before Vesting, their Award will Vest on the date of death and rule 8.4 will apply.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">If a Participant left employment before death either where rule 8.1 applied or where their Award did not lapse under rule 8.2 then, unless the Directors decide otherwise, any pro-rating of their Award will be by reference to the date the Participant left employment.</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;">Treatment of Options after leaving </p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">If the holder of an Option dies or otherwise leaves employment:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.6.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">before Vesting where rule 8.1 applies; or</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.6.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">after Vesting for any reason (except as described below)</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">their Option will be exercisable for 12 months from the later of:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.6.3</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">the date on which the Option Vests; and</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.6.4</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">the date on which the Participant left,</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">after which the Option will lapse, but the Directors may reduce or extend that period (but not beyond the Final Lapse Date). </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">However, if a Participant leaves employment after Vesting because of misconduct or breach of the terms of their employment, their Award will lapse on the day they leave employment unless the Directors determines otherwise and, for the avoidance of doubt, rule 6.5 will not apply.</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.7</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;">Detrimental activity</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">If a Participant leaves employment where rule 8.1 applies, unless the Directors decide otherwise, the Participant&#8217;s Award will lapse if he engages in Detrimental Activity and, if relevant, rule 6.5 will not apply.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">12</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.8</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU15"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">General</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.8.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">A Participant will only be treated as </font><font style="font-size:10pt;">&#8220;leaving employment&#8221;</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;"> when they are no longer an employee or director of any Member of the Group. </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.8.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">Notwithstanding anything else in this rule 8, a transfer of employment to or immediate re-employment by Rio Tinto plc or any subsidiary of it which Rio Tinto plc has Control of will not, whether or not that entity is a Member of the Group, constitute leaving employment for the purposes of these rules and these rules will continue to apply to that Participant as if Rio Tinto plc and its subsidiaries were each a Member of the Group, unless the Directors decide otherwise.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">9</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><a name="_Ref505264817"></a><a name="_Toc506366219"></a><a name="_Ref368996588"></a>Suspension</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">9.1.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><a name="_Ref498515272"></a><a name="_Ref470003358"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">Notwithstanding anything else in these rules, the Directors may, at any time before an Award has Vested or upon any cessation of employment and in their absolute discretion, decide that where there is an internal or external investigation which relates to, or may relate to, the Participant the Vesting of the Award (and consideration of the Vesting of the Award) will be postponed until the Consideration Point. The following will apply where there is a postponement under this rule 9.1.1:</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(i)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">The Award will continue and will neither Vest nor lapse until the Consideration Point.</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(ii)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">At the Consideration Point, the Committee will consider the use of its discretions and powers under this rule 9.1.1. and rule 10.1.1.&nbsp;&nbsp;For the avoidance of doubt, there may be an adjustment or further adjustment under this rule 9.1.1 at the Consideration Point.</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(iii)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">If a Participant leaves employment after the date on which the Award would have Vested, but for the operation of this rule 9.1.1 then, unless the Directors decide otherwise, rule 8.1 (Leaving employment) will not apply.  At the Consideration Point, the Committee will consider both the use of its discretions and powers under rules 8.1, 8.2, 9.1.1 and 10.1.1.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Award will Vest only to the relevant extent determined by the Committee.</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(iv)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">In making its determinations at the Consideration Point, the Committee can (without limitation) take into account the extent to which the Participant cooperates fully with all internal and external investigations, any matters, conduct or circumstances that arise from any such investigations and the conclusions and outcome of any investigation.</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">9.1.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">Rule 9.1.1 may be applied in different ways to different Participants in relation to the same or different events, or in different ways for the same Participant in relation to different Awards.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">

<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">9.1.3</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">The Directors will notify the Participant of any application of this rule 9.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">

<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">9.1.4</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">Without limiting rule 17.1, the Participant will not be entitled to any compensation in respect of any adjustment under this rule 9.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">

<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
