<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(d)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">for the avoidance of doubt, a time pro-rated reduction under this rule will not apply to a Bonus Deferral Award at all or, unless the Directors decide otherwise, to a Performance-based Award where the takeover occurs on or after the third anniversary of the Award Date.</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.1.3</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">To the extent that an Award has not Vested, it will lapse as to the balance, unless exchanged under rule 13.4 (Exchange of Awards). </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.1.4</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">An Option will be exercisable for a period of one month</font><font style="font-size:10pt;"> </font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">from the date of the takeover, after which it will lapse (whether or not it Vested under this rule).</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.1.5</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><a name="_Ref158542273"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">An Award will not Vest under rule 13.1.1 but will be exchanged under rule 13.4 (Exchange of Awards) if:</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(i)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">an offer to exchange Awards is made and accepted by a Participant; or</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(ii)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">the Directors, with the consent of the Acquiring Company, decides before the person obtains Control that the Awards will be automatically exchanged.</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_Ref158006412"></a>There is a <font style="font-weight:bold;">&#8220;takeover&#8221;</font> when:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(i)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">a person (or a group of persons acting in concert) obtains Control of the Company whether or not as a result of making an offer to acquire Shares; or</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(ii)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">under Section 411 of the Corporations Act, a court sanctions a compromise or arrangement in connection with the acquisition of Shares,</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">but not where the Directors determines rule 13.2 (Reconstruction) applies.</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref468304323"></a>Reconstruction</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">If there is any internal reconstruction, reorganisation, merger or acquisition of the Company which:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.2.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">is not intended to result in; or </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.2.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">does not involve </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">a significant change in the identity of the ultimate shareholders of the Company then the Directors may determine this rule 13.2 applies to any Awards which have not Vested by the day the reconstruction takes effect. The Directors will arrange for an Award to be replaced by an equivalent award of shares in the new parent company or companies as determined by the Directors. The Directors may amend any Performance Condition as it considers appropriate.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">18</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.3</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref158103917"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU21"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Demerger or Other Corporate Event</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.3.1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><a name="_Ref468304978"></a><a name="_Ref158541342"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">If the Directors becomes aware that the Company is or is expected to be affected by any demerger, distribution (other than an ordinary dividend), reconstruction or other transaction not falling within rule 13.1 (Takeover) which, in the opinion of the Directors, would affect the current or future value of any Award, the Directors may allow an Award to Vest (subject to rule 9 (Suspension) and rule 10 (Malus)) subject to any such conditions as the Directors may decide to impose. </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.8%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13.3.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">Where rule 13.3.1 applies: </font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(a)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">the Directors will determine the extent to which any Performance Condition has been satisfied to the date of the Vesting determined under rule 13.3.1 in accordance with its terms or, if they do not provide for it, in such manner as it considers reasonable, and the proportion of the Award which will Vest as a result;</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(b)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">unless the Directors decide otherwise, and except in the case of a Bonus Deferral Award or a Performance-based Award, the number of Shares in respect of which the Award would otherwise Vest under rule 13.3.1 will be reduced by the proportion which the number of complete days from the date of Vesting under rule 13.3.1 to the Vesting Date bears to the number of complete days in the period from the Award Date to the Vesting Date; </p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(c)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">unless the Directors decide otherwise, in the case of a Performance-based Award where the Vesting under rule 13.3.1 occurs before the third anniversary of the Award Date, the number of Shares in respect of which the Award would otherwise Vest under rule 13.3.1 will be reduced by the proportion which the number of complete days from the date of Vesting under rule 13.3.1 to the third anniversary of the Award Date bears to the number of complete days in the period from the Award Date to the third anniversary of the Award Date; and</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:15.59%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(d)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">for the avoidance of doubt, a time pro-rated reduction under this rule will not apply to a Bonus Deferral Award at all or unless the Directors decide otherwise, to a Performance-based Award where the takeover occurs on or after the third anniversary of the Award Date.</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_Ref404085669"></a>The Directors may, without obtaining the approval of the Company in general meeting, establish further plans (by way of schedules to the rules or otherwise) based on the rules, but modified to take account of local tax, exchange control or securities law in countries other than Australia. However, any Shares made available under such plans are treated as counting against any limits on individual and overall participation in the Plan. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU23"></a>The Company, any employing company or trustee of any employee benefit trust, may withhold any amounts or make such arrangements as it considers necessary to meet any liability to pay or account for any such taxation or social security contributions, other levies or any deductions required under the Rio Tinto Group&#8217;s policies on hypothetical taxes. <p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Participant would otherwise be entitled or the deduction of the amount of the liability from any cash amount payable to the Participant under the Plan or otherwise.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Participant will promptly do all things necessary to facilitate such arrangements and, notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the Plan, Vesting or the issue or transfer of Shares may be delayed until he does so.</p>

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Toc213663643"></a><a name="_Toc213663645"></a><a name="_Toc213663646"></a><a name="_Toc213663647"></a><a name="_Toc213663648"></a><a name="_Toc213663654"></a><a name="_Toc213663655"></a><a name="_Toc213663658"></a><a name="_Toc213663660"></a><a name="_Toc213663663"></a><a name="_Toc213663665"></a><a name="_Toc213663672"></a><a name="_Toc213663673"></a><a name="_Toc213663674"></a><a name="_Toc213663677"></a><a name="_Ref241989641"></a><a name="_Ref403507948"></a><a name="_Ref215994624"></a>Plan limits - 10 per cent </p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Subject to rule 16.3, an Award must not be granted if the number of Shares committed to be issued under that Award exceeds 10 per cent of the ordinary share capital of the Company in issue immediately before that day, when added to the number of Shares which have been issued, or committed to be issued, to satisfy Awards under the Plan, or options or awards under any other employee share plan operated by the Company, granted or awarded in the previous 10 years.</p>

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;"><a name="_Ref241990372"></a><a name="_Ref215994637"></a>Plan limits - 5 per cent </p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Subject to rule 16.3, an Award must not be granted if the number of Shares committed to be issued under that Award exceeds 5 per cent of the ordinary share capital of the Company in issue immediately before that day, when added to the number of Shares which have been issued, or committed to be issued, to satisfy Awards under the Plan, or options or awards under any other discretionary employee share plan adopted by the Company, granted or awarded in the previous 10 years.</p>

However, notices sent by or to a Participant who is working overseas will be deemed to have been given on the seventh day after the date of posting. Notices sent by electronic means, in the absence of evidence to the contrary, will be deemed to have been received on the day after sending.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">Shares may not be assigned, acquired or dealt with under this Plan if: </font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(ii)</font></p></td>

<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">17.10.2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:8.5pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">Nothing in this Plan will require the Company or any other member of the Rio Tinto Group to provide to any person any benefit that causes the Company or a member of the Rio Tinto Group either to breach its obligations or to be required to obtain shareholder approval under the Corporations Act or any other applicable laws, regulation or listing rules. Where such a benefit would be required to be provided to a person except for this clause, the benefit will be reduced to the extent necessary to allow it to be provided without the consequence of either breaching any applicable law, regulation or listing rule or requiring shareholder approval.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<td valign="top">

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:3pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10.5pt;">Governing law and jurisdiction</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Plan and all Awards and the construction are governed by the laws of Victoria, Australia, The Victorian Courts have non-exclusive jurisdiction in respect of disputes arising under or in connection with the Plan or any Award.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">24</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_Toc506366228"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU27"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Schedule</font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> 1</font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> </font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Grant of Forfeitable Shares</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Where an Award takes the form of Forfeitable Shares, the Participant must:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">enter into an agreement with the Grantor that, to the extent that the Award lapses under the Plan, the Shares are forfeited and they will immediately transfer their interest in them, for no consideration or nominal consideration, to any person (which may include the Company, where permitted) specified by the Grantor; and</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">provide any other documentation which the Directors consider necessary or desirable to give effect to the terms of the Award, including a power of attorney or blank stock transfer form.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">If the Participant does not do any of the actions above within a period specified by the Directors, the Award will lapse at the end of that period. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On or after the grant of Forfeitable Shares, the Grantor will procure that the relevant number of Shares are issued or transferred to the Participant or to another person to be held for the benefit of the Participant under the terms of the Plan. Where applicable, the share certificates or other documents of title relating to any Forfeitable Shares may be retained by the Grantor.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><br /></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">25</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:12pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_Toc506366229"></a><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU28"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Schedule</font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> 2</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Cash Awards</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Rules of the Rio Tinto Limited Equity Incentive Plan 2018 will apply to a right (a &#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Cash Award</font>&#8221;) to receive a cash sum granted or to be granted under this Schedule as if it was a Conditional Award or an Option, except as set out in this Schedule. Where there is any conflict between the Rules and this Schedule, the terms of this Schedule will prevail.</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">The Directors may grant or procure the grant of a Cash Award and designate it as a Conditional Award or an Option.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">Each Cash Award will relate to a given number of notional Shares.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">3</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">On the Vesting or exercise of the Cash Award the holder of that Award will be entitled to a cash sum which will be equal to the &#8220;</font><font style="font-size:10pt;">Cash Value</font><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">&#8221; of the notional Vested Shares, where the Cash Value of a notional Share is the market value of a Share on the date of Vesting or exercise of the Cash Award as determined by the Directors.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">4</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;"><font style="font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;">The cash sum payable under paragraph 3 above will be paid by the employer of the Participant (or any other Member of the Group as the Directors decide) as soon as practicable after the Vesting or exercise of the Cash Award, net of any deductions (on account of tax, hypothetical tax or similar liabilities) as may be required by law or as required under the Rio Tinto Group&#8217;s policies on hypothetical taxes.</font></p></td></tr></table></div>

<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:14pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:11pt;">Definitions</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In these Rules:</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Accumulation Period</font>&#8221; means the period during which a Participant&#8217;s Contributions are held before their application by the Nominee in acquiring Investment Shares and which must be longer than one month but not longer than 12 months (or any longer period determined by the Directors from time to time);</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">"<font style="font-weight:bold;">ASIC</font>" means the Australian Securities and Investments Commission;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">"<font style="font-weight:bold;">Associated Body Corporate</font>" means:</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(i)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">a body corporate that is a related body corporate of the Company;</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">

<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(ii)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">a body corporate that has voting power in the issuer of not less than 20 per cent; or</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(iii)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">a body corporate in which the issuer has voting power of not less than 20 per cent;</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">"<font style="font-weight:bold;">ASX Listing Rules</font>" means the Listing Rules of the Australian Securities Exchange in force from time to time;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">"<font style="font-weight:bold;">Australian Securities Exchange</font>" means Australian Securities Exchange Ltd (ACN 000 943 377) or its successor;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Award Date</font>&#8221; means the date on which Free Shares and/or Matching Shares are awarded to a Participant under the Plan;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Award System</font>&#8221; means the system of calculating the number of Free Shares to be awarded from time to time as adopted by the Directors;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Business Day</font>&#8221; means a day on which the Australian Securities Exchange is open for the transaction of business;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Change of Control</font>&#8221; means: </p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">

<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">when, under Section 411 of the Corporations Act, a court sanctions a compromise or arrangement in connection with the acquisition of Shares; or</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(ii)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">a person (or a group of persons acting in concert) obtains control (within the meaning of Section 50AA of the Corporations Act) of the Company in any other way;</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Company</font>&#8221; means Rio Tinto Limited (ACN 004 458 404);</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Conditional Award</font>&#8221; means a conditional right to acquire Shares awarded under the Plan;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Contributions</font>&#8221; means deductions from a Participant&#8217;s Salary, or where permitted by law other payment made by the Participant, for the purpose of allocating Investment Shares;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Corporate Event</font>&#8221; means, in relation to the Company: </p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">

<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">any demerger, delisting, distribution (other than an ordinary dividend) or other transaction, which, in the opinion of the Directors, might affect the current or future value of Plan Shares or any Conditional Award; or</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;border-top:Solid 0.75pt;padding-top:1pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<div align="left">

<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.79%;white-space:nowrap">

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;</font><font style="font-weight:bold;">Shares</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8221; means fully paid ordinary share</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">s in the capital of the Company</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> or, where the context permits, in the event of a </font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Change of Control</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">, any</font><font style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> security which forms part of any new holding;</font></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Subsidiary</font>&#8221; means a company which is a subsidiary of the Company within the meaning of Section 46 of the Corporations Act; and</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Vesting</font>&#8221; means a Participant becoming entitled to have the Shares subject to a Conditional Award transferred to him subject to the Plan and &#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Vest</font>&#8221; and &#8220;<font style="font-weight:bold;">Vested</font>&#8221; shall be construed accordingly. </p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:7pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:7.79%;text-indent:0%;font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">If the Plan is operated to provide Free Shares, Free Shares awarded to each Participant in any 12 month period must not have, on the Award Date, a Market Value of more than 200% of any applicable maximum Contributions limit, as determined by the Directors under rule 4.1.1 from time to time, or such other amount as determined by the Directors in respect of that award of Free Shares. </p>
